bodyParagraphs: **The Quickest and Most Efficient Way to Connect a Link ECU to Your Drive-by-Cable LS V8 Engine** This bundle provides the fastest, easiest, and most cost-effective solution for integrating a Link ECU with your Drive-by-Cable LS V8 engine. **Bundle Includes:** - G4X StormX ECU (8 Injector Drives and 8 Ignition Drives) - Terminated Engine Harness for GM LS GEN3/4* - LS Stepper Adapter Harness **Notes for Use with Gen 4 Engines:** 1. **Cam Sensor Harness Extension:** Required to accommodate the front-mounted cam sensor on Gen 4 LS engines. 2. **Crank Sensor Connector Modification:** A minor adjustment is necessary; refer to the "Crank Connector" section in the installation manual for detailed instructions. 3. **Injector Connector Adapters:** Most Gen 4 engines will require adapters to USCAR connectors. products.titleSource: Razor PDM Power Distribution Module
bodyParagraphs: Don't blow your fuse; modernise with a Razor PDM and never look back.

Leave behind the hassle and frustrations of outdated fuses and relays by upgrading to Link's Razor PDM. Instead of manual resets and replacements, enjoy smarter, tidier, and more reliable electrical management.

The Razor PDM (Power Distribution Module) is a programable computer that intelligently manages power delivery to components like lights, fans, or fuel pumps by processing inputs from ECUs, CAN keypads, switches, or sensors.
The Razor PDM continuously monitors current draw and circuit status making automated real time adjustments, and fixing issues in real time to eliminate damage and breakdowns.

Designed with flexibility in mind, multiple Razor PDMs can be connected via CAN to provide the exact number of inputs and outputs required. Their compact size allows them to be positioned close to the devices they control, reducing wiring length, voltage drop, cost and installation complexity.
Razor PDMs are ideal for builds wanting to replace traditional fuses and relays with intelligent power management, reduced wiring complexity and greater electrical reliability.
Models Supported The Razor PDM can control up to 4 high power outputs and 8 universal ADIO pins. Warnings PDMs will get hot under large loads.
